name: Milan Linate Airport

runway.v: main runway 18/36, 2,442 m long and 60 m wide (a second runway, 17/35, is 601 m x 22 m)

slots.v: a coordinated airport (slot allocation by Assoclearance)
slots.quote: ha classificato come aeroporti coordinati gli scali di: ... Milano Linate

handling.v: general aviation is handled at the A.T.A. traffic office; listed: ATA Linate West (06:00-22:00, summer 05:00-21:00), Sky Services (05:00-21:00, summer 04:00-20:00) and Universal Aviation Italy (06:00-22:00, summer 05:00-21:00)
handling.quote: All operations referring to General Aviation traffic will be carried out at the A.T.A. traffic office.

missing: operator (no verbatim operator statement; the data is published by SEA S.p.A.)
notes: ENAV eAIP (AIP Italia) needs an ENAV account and could not be opened, so customs, night rules and GA rules from AD 2 are missing. All facts except slots come from SEA's 'Technical data' page (no date; © 2026). The page does not say whether the handler hours and the Tuesday closure are UTC or local; the bracketed times appear to be the summer values; they are copied as written, not converted. The SEA noise action plan only mentions an engine-run ban 22:00-05:00 and a national night-flight decree (D.P.R. 476/99) without terms, so no curfew was recorded. Slot quote from ENAC page (updated 14/11/2024); the coordinator is Assoclearance ('l’associazione Assoclearance che è stata incaricata del coordinamento'). Whether GA needs a slot is not stated there.
